description: Latest water level at one Environment Agency gauge, compared with its typical range (low, normal or high), plus the latest flow where the gauge measures it. Useful for boaters, anglers and residents asking whether the river is high right now. Source: Environment Agency real-time flood-monitoring API; readings are usually 15 minutes apart and old readings are flagged stale. Level is a gauge height, not water depth, and this is not a flood warning service. (cost: 1 credit)

station_id.description: string, required, Environment Agency station reference, e.g. 2200TH (Reading); find ids with river_levels_near

name: river_level_now
